response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT a.account_id, c.town_city AS town, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Accounts a JOIN Financial_Transactions f ON f.account_id = a.account_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.account_id, c.town_city) SELECT account_id, town, cnt AS transaction_count, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY town) AS share_of_town_transactions, cnt * 1.0 / AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM t ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC LIMIT 10
